annotations.title: Aluminum and stainless bar grating load calculator

description: Safe load, deflection and the lightest bearing bar for aluminum 6063-T6 and stainless 304, 316, 304L and 316L bar grating at 1-3/16 in bar centres.

deflection.description: Deflection limit in inches, span240 (span / 240), span360 (span / 360) or none (strength only). Ignored for ped.

load.description: ped = pedestrian, 100 lb/sq ft with a 1/4 in deflection limit; uni = uniform load you give in value; con = concentrated load at mid-span you give in value.

material.description: Aluminum 6063-T6, stainless 304 or 316, or stainless 304L or 316L.

span_in.description: Clear span in inches, 24 to 108 (the range of the published tables). Give only one of span_in, span_mm. Default 36 in.

value.description: The load to check when load is uni (lb/sq ft) or con (lb per ft of grating width). Required for uni and con.

name: aluminum_stainless_bar_grating_load_calculator
